cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

mechanism: A makes investigating evidence against itself into a pupil exercise it controls, concealing culpability behind helpful supervision.
confusable: Unlike innocent teaching, A redirects away from the incriminating implications while volunteering useful investigative handling.
comparison: Physical glue evidence versus coffee treatment of a plant.
seedUse: D13 glue/vase clue sequence is preserved, with S05 praise and correction actively redirecting observation into evidence handling.
